summary: This is a routine 8-K filing reporting an amendment and restatement of an existing credit facility. Cboe Global Markets, Inc., as guarantor, entered into an agreement with Cboe Clear Europe N.V., as borrower, to extend the term of the facility to June 25, 2027, maintain aggregate commitments at EUR 1.2 billion (with an accordion to EUR 1.7 billion), and update certain provisions. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. The filing discloses a routine extension of credit terms, not a transformative corporate event. No price, premium, or deal mechanics are involved.
